title: Carnapped vehicle recovered in Bulacan hours after report

blocks.text: A missing multi‑purpose vehicle was recovered in Marilao, Bulacan hours after being reported to the Quezon City Police District (QCPD) on Sept. 3. The red metallic 2025 Mitsubishi Xpander was logged with the District Anti‑Carnapping Unit (DACU) at about 2 p.m. after the complainant said he had entrusted it to alias “Jef” under an agreement that the latter would assume its installment payments. However, the agreed payments were reportedly not made, and the vehicle was not returned to the complainant. DACU personnel immediately launched a follow-up operation to locate the vehicle. Police later received information that the Xpander had been spotted in Marilao, prompting the operatives to proceed to the area to verify the report. The vehicle was not immediately found, prompting the police to conduct surveillance and a stakeout. After about an hour, the vehicle arrived in the area. The operatives approached Jef, who was in possession of the vehicle, identified themselves as police officers, and informed him of the complaint. Jef voluntarily surrendered the vehicle to the DACU at about 3:30 p.m. without resistance. The recovered vehicle was brought to the DACU for documentation, verification, and proper disposition.
